decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several Bluetooth speakers across different price points and use cases. My consideration set includes top-rated portable options from Bose and JBL, a high-end bookshelf system from Edifier, and more budget-friendly portable speakers from Oraolo and DOSS. Ultimately, I chose the JBL Go 3 because it offers the highest rating (4.7) in the portable category at a very accessible price of $39.99. While the Bose SoundLink is a strong contender, the JBL provides excellent brand reliability and waterproof/dustproof features for outdoor use at a third of the cost. The Edifier was excluded from the final choice as it is a stationary home setup rather than a versatile portable speaker.
